claims.quote: Our rock-solid support to Ukraine is vital for keeping us safe here in the UK
claims.statement: UK support for Ukraine is vital for keeping the UK safe.

claims.quote: we are with you for as long as it takes
claims.statement: The UK will stand with Ukraine for as long as it takes.

claims.quote: Russia’s aggression cannot be allowed to succeed on our continent.
claims.statement: Russia's aggression cannot be allowed to succeed in Europe.

claims.quote: I urge partners to back the ban on Russian LNG, like we have done in the UK, to curtail the war chest funding Putin so desperately wants.
claims.statement: Partners should back a ban on Russian LNG to curtail the funding Putin relies on for war.

claims.quote: which have proven extremely effective against jet-powered drones that are being used to strike far beyond the front lines in Ukraine
claims.statement: British Lightweight Multirole Missiles have proven extremely effective against jet-powered drones.

claims.quote: The drones are faster and can fly far higher than propeller-driven Shaheds, making them harder to detect and destroy before they hit targets.
claims.statement: The jet-powered drones are faster and fly higher than propeller-driven Shaheds, making them harder to detect and destroy.

facts.quote: The UK has already committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5000 LMMs to Ukraine over the next four years
facts.statement: The UK has committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5000 British Lightweight Multirole Missiles to Ukraine over the next four years.

facts.quote: The Prime Minister has also asked Ministers to draw up further sanctions, military aid, and fiscal packages to provide urgent support in the coming weeks.
facts.statement: The Prime Minister has asked Ministers to draw up further sanctions, military aid and fiscal packages.

facts.quote: This comes after the Foreign Secretary did the same with partners at the Warsaw Security Forum yesterday [TUE].
facts.statement: The Foreign Secretary urged partners at the Warsaw Security Forum to fully implement a ban on Russian LNG.

facts.quote: Ahead of the two leaders meeting today, Prime Minister Andy Burnham said:
facts.statement: Prime Minister Andy Burnham made statements ahead of the meeting with President Zelenskyy.

facts.quote: Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey said:
facts.statement: Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey made a statement on Ukraine and Russian LNG.

facts.statement: The UK is delivering £45 million of surface-to-air missiles to Ukraine.
